description: Land Title Settlement Department - Calling for Claims to Land Parcel in Kanewala, Horana D/S Division, Kalutara  District - Cad. Map No. 530179 and to 15 ther Land parcels
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of notices calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It deals specifically with land ownership claims, cadastral maps, land title determinations, and land registration processes across multiple districts. The content focuses exclusively on land and property-related matters, fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which includes "land registrations, property ownership, land titles" and "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals."
